passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My father is a doctor, and he works at a hospital.
phrases.ko: 나의 아버지는 의사예요. 아버지는 병원에서 일해요.
phrases.zh: 我的爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。
phrases.py: wǒ de bà bà shì yī shēng， tā zài yī yuàn gōng zuò。
tā yòu gāo yòu shàn liáng。

phrases.en: He goes to work in the morning.
phrases.py: tā zǎo shàng qù shàng bān。

phrases.en: His work is important, but he still smiles at us.
phrases.ko: 아버지의 일은 중요하지만, 그래도 우리에게 미소를 지어요.
phrases.zh: 他的工作很重要，可是他仍然对我们笑。
phrases.py: tā de gōng zuò hěn zhòng yào， kě shì tā réng rán duì wǒ men xiào。

phrases.en: He can cook dinner for our family.
phrases.ko: 아버지는 우리 가족을 위해 저녁을 요리할 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 他会给我们家人做晚饭。
phrases.py: tā huì gěi wǒ men jiā rén zuò wǎn fàn。

phrases.en: I love my father because he cares for us.
phrases.ko: 아버지는 우리를 돌봐 주셔서 나는 아버지를 사랑해요.
phrases.zh: 我爱爸爸，因为他照顾我们。
phrases.py: wǒ ài bà bà， yīn wèi tā zhào gù wǒ men。

phrases.en: He loves our family very much.
phrases.py: tā yě hěn ài wǒ men yī jiā rén。

phrases.en: After work, he asks about my school day.
phrases.ko: 일이 끝나면 아버지는 나의 학교 하루에 대해 물어요.
phrases.zh: 下班以后，他会问我学校里的事。
phrases.py: xià bān yǐ hòu， tā huì wèn wǒ xué xiào lǐ de shì。

phrases.en: He is proud when I try hard.
phrases.zh: 我努力的时候，他很骄傲。
phrases.py: wǒ nǔ lì de shí hòu， tā hěn jiāo ào。

phrases.en: My little sister runs to him at the door.
phrases.py: mèi mèi huì pǎo dào mén kǒu zhǎo tā。

phrases.en: I want to be kind like my father.
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng xiàng bà bà yī yàng shàn liáng。

full_passage_spoken: My father is a doctor, and he works at a hospital. He is tall and kind. He goes to work in the morning. His work is important, but he still smiles at us. He can cook dinner for our family. I love my father because he cares for us. He loves our family very much. After work, he asks about my school day. He is proud when I try hard. My little sister runs to him at the door. I want to be kind like my father.
full_passage_zh: 我的爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。他又高又善良。他早上去上班。他的工作很重要，可是他仍然对我们笑。他会给我们家人做晚饭。我爱爸爸，因为他照顾我们。他也很爱我们一家人。下班以后，他会问我学校里的事。我努力的时候，他很骄傲。妹妹会跑到门口找他。我想像爸爸一样善良。
